title: Lues Scythe
description: Adds in a totally original weapon to Minecraft (sprites probably a placeholder)
body:
Adds in a (probably buggy) new weapon to minecraft and is totaly an original idea
Features: A new weapon and 2 new enchantments (only work with it atm)

### THIS IS FOR THE 2.0.0 VERSION!


<details>
<summary>V 2.0.0 Description</summary>

- Slashing: Goes up to level 3 and does 3 total slashes + an extra if you count the vanila one. Cooldown of 35 and is shared with Lifesteal
- Lifesteal: Goes up to level 3 with the healing of 0.25, 0.5, and 1. Cooldown lasts 3 seconds and is shared with Slashing (Heals 1 per slash)
- Counter: Sneak + Right Click to counter, Reflects arrows and should work on most entitys. Cooldown of 15 seconds
- Strong Stance: Increases the Counter damage

**These are subject to change as of the time of writing this Scythe's 2.0.0 version is in BETA!**

</details>



- Slashing: Max level III, Does a slash attack upon hit and does more depending on the level. Stuns both the attacker and the recever (also instantkills creepers at this time so you dont get exploded mid attack)
- Lifesteal: Max level III, (Only works with Slashing atm) Gives health upon a slash (amount varys on level)

Known issues:
- Scythe shading is weird on the item (planned to be fixed just give me a bit)
- Mod being scuffed in general (sorry)

Some extra info that you might wanna know:

- I = Internal version
- This mod is a W.I.P
- Multiplayer support unknown (No testing has been done)
- Sprites are a placeholder and are from Stardew Valley atm
